title: Data on Cost Incurred to Accelerate Development of HDB BTO Projects Announced to Date
what_it_is: Data on Cost Incurred to Accelerate Development of HDB BTO Projects Announced to Date

sections.label: BTO delays and completion dates
sections.summary: HDB reduced BTO projects delayed beyond the Estimated Completion Date from about 90% in 2021 to about 40% in January 2023, without incurring acceleration costs.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for National Development (Mr Tan Kiat How) (for the Minister for National Development)
sentences.text: In January 2023, we have reduced the proportion of BTO projects delayed beyond the Estimated Completion Date (ECD) from about 90% in 2021, to about 40%.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for National Development (Mr Tan Kiat How) (for the Minister for National Development)
sentences.text: HDB's ongoing and future BTO construction projects that have been announced to date are planned, based on the estimated completion dates indicated during the BTO launches.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for National Development (Mr Tan Kiat How) (for the Minister for National Development)
sentences.text: Notwithstanding efforts made to keep up the supply of BTOs to meet the strong housing demand, HDB has been able to meet these completion dates without incurring acceleration costs.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for National Development (Mr Tan Kiat How) (for the Minister for National Development)
sentences.text: To reduce construction delays, HDB has been working closely with our contractors and agency partners to put in place extensive measures.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for National Development (Mr Tan Kiat How) (for the Minister for National Development)
sentences.text: These include sourcing for workers overseas for contractors to address manpower shortages and streamlining processes to expedite approvals.

sections.label: Build quality and worksite safety
sections.summary: The passage states build quality and worksite safety are not compromised, and describes working with contractors to keep projects at pace per milestone.

sentences.speaker: Mr Tan Kiat How
sentences.text: The last thing we want is for accidents to happen resulting in the unfortunate losses of life.

sentences.speaker: Mr Tan Kiat How
sentences.text: These are two areas that we will not compromise on: the quality of the build, as well as safety at the worksites.

sentences.speaker: Mr Tan Kiat How
sentences.text: It is a little bit of a technical term in the industry where we pay the contractor to put in additional resources and, thus, incur additional cost to bring forward and accelerate the completion of their construction contracts.

sentences.speaker: Mr Tan Kiat How
sentences.text: In this case, we are in a slightly different situation where we are working very closely with the contractors and the builders to ensure that existing projects continue at pace, at a steady stead, per milestone.

sentences.speaker: Mr Tan Kiat How
sentences.text: They have gone through very tough times over the last two and half years – supply shocks, manpower shortages and many other shocks due to situations outside their control; COVID-19, the war in Ukraine and Russia, and so on.

sentences.speaker: Mr Tan Kiat How
sentences.text: It is a very different situation whereby the contractors actually have the luxury to bring in additional resources by working closely and collaboratively to streamline the processes across the entire build and value chain, to make sure that work continues safely while not compromising on quality.
